player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''vader106''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.

starting.card: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe

cards: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe
posted: Hunt down and Duel the Jedi
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
notes: Posted 22 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (10)': the Objective, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Start Your Engines!, Sebulba's Podracer, Epic Duel and Watto's Box; all count toward the 60. Visage Of The Emperor is shown as the starting effect because the Objective deploys it.

Posted 'Hunt down and Duel the Jedi' dested Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (the description calls the deck 'Hunt Down Sevens'); 'Holotheatre' / 'Meditation Chamber' the Executor sites; 'Visage' (starting and 'Visage x6' under Effects, called 'sevens' in the strategy) Visage Of The Emperor, not the starship Visage; 'Podrace' Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark); 'Podrace Arena' Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark); 'Sebulba's Pod' Sebulba's Podracer.

Posted 'Maul Site' dested Tatooine: Desert Landing Site (Maul deploys free there); 'Choke Vader' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Emperor Palpy' Emperor Palpatine; 'Iggy with gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun (the strategy uses him to capture Qui-Gon); 'Janus' Janus Greejatus; 'Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Mara' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand.

Posted 'Circle' dested The Circle Is Now Complete; 'Ommni Box combo' Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Reacter Terminal' Reactor Terminal; 'Vader's Stick' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Maul's Stick' Maul's Lightsaber; 'Mara's Stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Intruder Missle' Intruder Missile.
'Grabber' is not named (the strategy says only 'grab retrival'); kept as posted (UNKNOWN). No Escape is the 2001 Effect.
The Effects header says 13 but 12 cards are listed; the deck still totals 60 as published.
The strategy also mentions 'Prince' (Prince Xizor) and says Come Here You Big Coward 'should be in there, remove something for it'; neither is in the posted list, so neither is added.

Same Visage Of The Emperor and Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith counts as posted (7 Visage, 5 Vader) although both are unique; the strategy says the extra copies are destiny sevens to be put back with Janus and Reactor Terminal.
